title: Where A Thing Is
label: ch:ml-place-words
canDo: I can say that something is on, under, in front of or behind something else.

payoff.summary: From cold: all four place-words, the owner-ending the noun in front of them must carry, and the in-ending visible inside three of the four.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these five atoms and the payoff assesses all five. The owner-ending is not new: it is the genitive from chapter 78, unchanged, because kaseerayude mukalil is literally 'the chair's top-part'.
